body: Implement Linux process confinement for loop fixer execution using bubblewrap (bwrap) / Landlock LSM. Restrict filesystem write access strictly to workspace target directory, blocking home, credentials, parent dirs, and other repos. Allow loop execution on Linux without --loop-unsafe when bwrap/landlock is active.
title: Implement Linux process confinement (Landlock/bubblewrap) for loop fixer execution
